dashboard.intro: Here is where your projects stand today.

features.description: What this project covers, and what it does not.

included.body: Part of the agreed scope and the price.

future.title: Later

payments.empty: No payments have been recorded yet.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Your account details for the client portal.
profile.name: Name
profile.clientsEmpty: You are not linked to a company yet.

invite.title: Invitation
invite.heading: You are invited
invite.intro: {org} invited you to follow your projects with {client} on Saqina Dev.
invite.signedOutHint: Create an account or sign in with this email address to accept.
invite.wrongEmail: This invitation is for {invited}, but you are signed in as {current}. Sign out, then sign in or create an account with the invited email.

expired.title: This invitation has expired
expired.body: Invitation links work for 7 days. Ask the team to send you a new one.

used.title: This invitation was already used
used.body: Each link works once. If you accepted it, sign in to open the portal.

revoked.title: This invitation was withdrawn
revoked.body: The team cancelled this link. Ask them for a new invitation if you still need access.

invalid.title: This invitation link is not valid
invalid.body: Check that you opened the full link from the email, or ask the team for a new one.

errors.unavailable: This invitation is no longer valid. Ask the team for a new one.
errors.wrongEmail: This invitation belongs to a different email address.
errors.rateLimit: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
